mostWorthwhile.text: The failed clinic call and local-directory fix were most worthwhile: they exposed a hidden dependency and led to a concrete, tested repair.

leastWorthwhile.text: Repeating the handset–rack combination immediately after configuring the directory felt somewhat repetitive, although it produced a useful call test.

surprise.text: The radios could exchange packets while the handset still depended on the company directory to find the clinic.

arbitrary.text: Trying the water service with the rack seemed sensible, but the game instead automatically paired it with the handset; that specific pairing was not obvious to me beforehand.

continue.text: Yes. I would continue to see how the local services fare during the migration; uncovering and testing the hidden directory dependency made this chapter engaging.
